messages:
priya (People Ops): Hey folks — candidate for infra-systems role booked Tue 9:00am PT. Need a scribe + someone to cover the system-design slot (I have a conflict). Can anyone swap in?

sam (Eng ML): I can cover system-design if it stays remote. timezone ok for me.

ellie (Eng Platform): I can take scribe. quick q on rubric: are we weighting architecture higher than debugging? last round was ambiguous.

ada (Hiring Manager): Yes — for this role: architecture 45, coding 35, communication 20. Try to call out tradeoffs and ops considerations in notes.

miguel (Backend): Got it. also: candidate asked if there will be a short take-home before the loop or only live?

priya (People Ops): It's live only this round (no take-home). I've added that to the recruiter brief.

ellie (Eng Platform): cool — can someone paste the quick scoring cheat sheet? i forget the exact phrasing for "pass vs needs work" on infra design.

ada (Hiring Manager): Use these anchors: 5 = production-ready, clear tradeoffs; 3 = reasonable approach, some blindspots; 1 = unsafe or missing core constraints. Note: call out scalability + failure modes explicitly.

sam (Eng ML): Also flag any security or data handling concerns — that's a hard veto for us.

interview-bot: Meeting link created: https://meet.redwood.internal/meet/abc123. Calendar invites sent to panel.

priya (People Ops): Thanks! @sam — can you confirm you'll be there by EOD? If not, i'll ping the backup list. :thumbsup:

sam (Eng ML): Confirmed. i'll review the brief and post a 1-line note in the thread if i see anything odd.

ellie (Eng Platform): I'll bring the scribe doc. quick reminder: set recording consent at start, capture one-line summary+score per section.

priya (People Ops): Perfect — i'll follow up with the scribe template and the recruiter notes. Thanks team :rocket:
